deviations_from_plan: Extra module PqxdhRecordLiftChainLift holds chain_lift (plan C3 puts it in ChainHybrid): the target needs ChainBills (C4), which imports ChainHybrid, and ChainAlias (C3).

The generic supported-prefix lemmas behind the C3 support-level policy congruence (lawEq_bind_support, reaches_*, safe_of_reaches, safe_mono, chain_lookup_present, lookup_present, present_preserved, lookup_absent, run_agrees, agrees_update) live in PqxdhRecordLiftSeedPolicy, because seed_prefix (C1) needs them first; ChainHybrid applies them with MixedWorld.protocol_run_bounds (run_kdf, run_depth).

C4 bills the prefix and the suffix of a cut with one whole-run closed-form cap programCoins each and every lookup at a full 76-byte reply under every policy, instead of WorldBudget real cap plus 76 * (S + 51 * R) with separate qPrefix, qSuffix and T caps per cut: observerBill = 2 * programCoins + 44 + decision.
The 32 retained bytes of a seed cut (seedObserver_total) are rounded up to 44 so that one bill covers every index (observerAt_total).

Consequence: the bill is explicit and proved but not tight; advantage coefficients are unchanged and the bill is a function of BillInput only. Recorded in doc/impl/record-lift-chain-bills.md and doc/impl/record-lift-chain-lift.md.
